en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural village landscape with fields in the foreground and a cluster of houses and farm buildings in the middle distance. On the left stands a prominent church with a tall tower and spire. The text "Gruss aus Planitz." is printed in red at the bottom, and a small publisher's line "Brück & Sohn, Meissen" with a number appears lower left.
